privacy.title: Your privacy comes first
privacy.lead: We only ever share your city and dates, never your location.
points: Layovers show as a city and a date window — never a hotel, street or live position.
You choose who can see you: friends, your airline or all verified crew.
Your phone number and date of birth are never shown to anyone.

guidelines.title: Community & safety guidelines
guidelines.lead: CrewUp works because crew look out for each other.
points: Be yourself: use your real name and photo.
Respect boundaries — no harassment, pressure or unwanted contact.
Keep layover plans in public places until you know someone.
Never share another crew member's roster or location.
Report anything that feels wrong. We review every report.
guidelines.zeroTolerance: CrewUp has zero tolerance for abusive content or users. We review reports within 24 hours and remove content or accounts that break these rules.
guidelines.accept: I agree to the CrewUp community guidelines

consent.title: Before we read your roster
consent.lead: CrewUp uses {{provider}}, an AI service, to find the flights and layovers in your roster.
points: Your file is sent to {{provider}} only to read your flights.
From PDFs, we remove names, staff numbers and hotel names first. Screenshots are sent as they are, so crop out anything you'd rather not share.
We delete your file right after it's read. Only the trips you confirm are saved.
Prefer not to? You can enter your trips manually instead.

tips.title: Safety tips
tips.lead: Most crew meetups are easy and fun. A few habits keep them that way.

sections.title: Meet in public
sections.body: Pick a busy café, bar or a group meet for a first hangout. Avoid going to someone's hotel room or home until you know them.

sections.title: Tell a friend
sections.body: Share where you're going, who you're meeting and when you expect to be back. Keep your phone charged.

sections.title: Get yourself there and back
sections.body: Arrange your own transport and keep enough local currency or a card for a ride back to your hotel.

sections.title: Trust your instincts
sections.body: If something feels off, leave. You never owe anyone an explanation. Keep an eye on your drink.

sections.title: Report or block
sections.body: Report and Block are at the bottom of every profile and under ••• at the top of a chat. Press and hold a message to report it. Blocking is instant and the other person isn't told.

sections.title: We review every report
sections.body: Our team reviews reports within 24 hours and removes people who break our guidelines.

tips.emergencyBody: Contact local emergency services first, then your company's crew control. 112 works on mobile phones in many countries.
